10.answer: In Hawa the Bus Driver, Hawa earns a living as a professional driver. Handling a large passenger vehicle demonstrates skill and responsibility. Doing the job despite assumptions about women challenges the idea that driving is exclusively men’s work. In Mabala the Farmer, Mama Martina works in agriculture to support the family. Her practical knowledge helps her judge the demands of farming more realistically than Mabala does. Her example and advice make her a source of guidance within the household. Both readers therefore portray women as economically active and capable of leadership beyond cooking.
10.explanation: Use three supported points per reader, naming the women and linking their work, skills or influence to the claim. Other accurate examples from the listed readers are valid.
